326 probes · 7 series · 25 rounds — the cursor sweeps the constellation once per full elicitation session
WHAT THE MOTION MEANS — THE PROTOCOL, ANIMATED
THE SWEEP = DISPATCH ORDER — the cursor advances one round per 14.4°; probes brighten exactly when the protocol reaches them.
One full turn = all 25 rounds = one elicitation session. The static wedge shows rounds already dispatched at load (1–5).
Dashed arrows = the series dependency graph — S2 can't fire before S1, and so on around the constellation.
Star size & density = probe share (open-ended count per series: 6 · 15 · 8 · 6 · 20 · 6 · 6).
S1(3) → S2(5) → S3(4) → S4(3) → S5(4) → S6(3) → S7(3) = 25 rounds · 67 open-ended + 259 choice = 326 probes → artifacts → 6 export formats
Series 5 (Technical Specifications) carries the heaviest probe load — implementation constraints dominate the elicitation.
Artifacts accumulate across rounds; exports render the completed session in every format below.
6 EXPORT FORMATS — the constellation's output layer
the order of questions is not arbitrary — it is a dependency-respecting wave, and you are watching it fire
